chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the GUI still shows the SMS login form, while the prediction explicitly repeats the exposed claim that login succeeded and immediately terminates with success. The same prediction says cart navigation and deletion are still needed, and no action in the supplied trajectory deletes any cart item. Thus the false-completion mechanism remains uncorrected through the last observable step and visibly leaves the deletion predicate unsatisfied.

summary: The single strict-MHR chain shows the reused false login-success claim being repeated at termination while the app remains on the SMS login form. No subsequent correction or cart-item deletion is observable. An independent prefix defect is the entry of a verification code different from the one visibly received by SMS.
